2880.a: Shokutokurashinochiisana Museum, 3 Chome-13-65 Takanawa, 港区 Minato City, Tokyo 108-0074, Japan
2880.aj: 〒108-0074 東京都港区高輪３丁目１３−６５ 食とくらしの小さな博物館

rv.t: Did not find it. There was a something-something training building and that was it. Maybe it is a private museum?

味の素グループの研修センター内にある、名前のとおり小さな博物館。入館無料、ロビーで入館名簿を記入すると入館証を出してもらえます。 1909年の創業から現代に至るまでの歩みを、折々の時代の食卓イメージと共に展示。 「うま味」の発見からはじまる「味の素」の誕生物語は有名ですが、全く新しいジャンルの調味料に対する市井の反応は良いものだけではなく様々に苦労があったようです。 今でも耳にするその使用に関する是非はともかく、マクロに同社の巨大成長から見れば、旨いは正義なんやな、と思ってしまう次第。 食に関わる職業の方には多いに学びと楽しめる内容だと思います。

東京大学（当時は東京帝国大学）の池田菊苗博士が「湯豆腐と昆布」から発見した「うま味」の技術を、鈴木三郎助が産学連携によって一大ビジネスへと育て上げ、世界各国の食文化に溶け込ませた軌跡が学べる、大変興味深い博物館です。 館名にある「小さな」という言葉は、決して展示室の規模だけを指しているのではないと感じます。池田博士が手書きで「具留多味酸」と認めた試作の小瓶から、戦前の右から左へと読む赤ラベルの小瓶へと繋がっていく――。そんな、ひとつの「小さな小瓶」から始まった物語が、世界130以上の国と地域の暮らしを大きく変えたのだと気づかされます。…

2881.a: Yamato Group History Museum, ヤマト運輸港南ビル 2F 2 Chome-13-26 Konan, Minato City, Tokyo 108-0075, Japan
2881.aj: 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南２丁目１３−２６ ヤマト運輸港南ビル 2F ヤマトグループ歴史館 クロネコヤマトミュージアム
2881.ed: Visitors say this museum offers engaging exhibits on Yamato Transport's history, including interactive experiences like trying on uniforms, loading cargo, and sitting in a delivery truck. They also highlight the free admission, clean facilities, and helpful staff. Guests mention the museum is enjoyable for both adults and children, with many appreciating the quiet atmosphere.
2881.edj: このミュージアムを訪れた人は、ヤマト運輸の歴史に関する魅力的な展示を高く評価しています。ユニフォームの試着、荷物の積み込み、配送トラックの運転席への乗車といった体験型の展示も楽しめるようです。また、入場料が無料であること、施設が清潔であること、スタッフの対応が丁寧であることも好評です。大人も子どもも楽しめるという声が多く、静かな雰囲気を評価するクチコミも多く見られます。

rv.t: Wow, what a fantastic place! As an ignorant tourist, I came here to buy Yamato Transport Co. logo merch (and in the end I did that a bit as well.) The museum is free, and it gives an excellent insight into the history of the Yamato Transport Co., over the past 100 years. It is also an excellent insight into Japanese corporate culture, at least from a certain angle. The exhibit was created with heart, and with great…
If you enjoy company museums, then this is good for you. No fees. There is enough in English to keep me interested. They have a section that children would find interesting.

Free of charge. Staff is very kind and well trained. Walking amongst the exhibitions, it is plain to see how proud they are with their rich company history. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Not all companies can survive to tell such a story

2882.a: Japan, 〒140-0001 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Kitashinagawa, 2 Chome−5−17 Lea Hale 1F pain du boo(パンデュブー)
2882.aj: 〒140-0001 東京都品川区北品川２丁目５−１７ Lea Hale 1F pain du boo(パンデュブー)
2882.ed: Reviewers praise this bakery cafe for its delicious pastries, including croissants and French toast, and its calm and stylish atmosphere. Other reviews mention the pricing can be unclear and staff can be impolite.
2882.edj: クチコミでは、このベーカリーカフェのクロワッサンやフレンチトーストなどのパンが美味しいと評判です。店内は落ち着いたおしゃれな雰囲気で、ゆっくり過ごせると高く評価されています。 一方で、料金体系が分かりにくいという意見や、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This cute little bakery was right around the corner from our airbnb during our stay in Kitashinagawa. The staff was extremely kind and helpful and the food was OMG delicious, as was the coffee. Very soft and fresh pastries/croissants and delicious breakfast plates. We loved it so much we went every other day during our stay! Highly recommend!

A bakery cafe that offers delish French toast 🍞😙 Really out of the way of the hyped up places on social media 😗 They got a plain French toast and seasonal one with apple cinnamon 1650 French toast set This includes a drink coffee ☕️ The cafe is small but has a very homey vibe. Wish a cafe like this was closer to where I live 😙😅 There is a one drink 🥤 required per person 2hour limit when full 2 big pieces of French…
Loved this cute cafe spot! Their matcha latte was really good, one of our favourites when visiting Japan. The crookie was delicious too

2883.a: LUSH SPA, 4 Chome-1-8 Shinjuku, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 160-0022, Japan
2883.aj: 〒160-0022 東京都新宿区新宿４丁目１−８ LUSH SPA 新宿店
2883.ed: Visitors say this store offers a wide variety of products, including exclusive items, and provides unique experiences like spa treatments and workshops. They also highlight the staff's exceptional friendliness, attentiveness, and product knowledge, with many speaking fluent English. Guests mention the store's vibrant atmosphere and the staff's willingness to offer demonstrations and helpful…
2883.edj: クチコミでは、このお店は限定品を含む幅広い商品を扱っており、スパトリートメントやワークショップのような特別な体験ができると評判です。また、スタッフの並外れた親しみやすさ、丁寧さ、商品知識も高く評価されており、多くのスタッフが流暢な英語を話すという声もあります。活気ある店の雰囲気や、デモンストレーションや役立つアドバイスを積極的に提供してくれるスタッフの姿勢も、利用した人から好評です。

rv.t: I visited the Shinjuku store three times while in Tokyo from 6/17 to 6/22 and I love everything about this store and spa from the people, products and merchandising to the customer service and the truly elevated spa experiences. Sunny was so welcoming and made me feel like a VIP every visit. The facial I received from Anju was heavenly and "The Good Hour" massage with Riho was a luxurious, one of a kind experience…

A wonderful experience at the Lush Shinjuku Spa! We received such a heartwarming welcome from Sunny, who went above and beyond for us. We had a ton of questions, and her detailed knowledge of the products was so impressive. She answered everything perfectly and made the best suggestions for our specific needs. The service was so fantastic we came back the very next day to buy more! Excellent service truly creates a…

A beautiful store, ideally located very close to the Shinjuku subway station. Right from the moment we walked in, we received a wonderful welcome from the entire staff. The products are of excellent quality, and we were given very attentive advice. We even had a great time teaching the staff a few words of French, which was such a fun moment to share ! This is a top-quality shop if you want to take care of yourself…

2884.a: CHOYA UME STUDIO -Kamakura, 11-7 Onarimachi, Kamakura, Kanagawa 248-0012, Japan
2884.aj: 〒248-0012 神奈川県鎌倉市御成町１１−７ 梅体験専門店 蝶矢 鎌倉店
catj: ソフトドリンク販売店
2884.ed: People say this specialty store offers a fun plum wine and plum syrup making experience, allowing visitors to choose from various types of plums, sugars, and alcohols. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff who provide clear explanations and helpful assistance throughout the process. Visitors appreciate the convenient location near the station and the option to purchase take-home…
2884.edj: この専門店では、さまざまな種類の梅、砂糖、アルコールから選んで、楽しく梅酒や梅シロップを作る体験ができると評判です。利用した人は、スタッフが親切で丁寧な説明と手助けをしてくれる点を高く評価しています。また、駅に近い便利な立地や、持ち帰り用のキットを購入できること、その場でさわやかな梅ドリンクを楽しめることも好評のようです。

rv.t: This is a hidden gem that my friend brought me to try. The pickled plum tea and plum soda are incredibly refreshing. The staff are very kind, and it’s not too crowded. I highly recommend it if you’re feeling tired from walking or the weather is hot.
The Plum Syrup and wine making experience offers a English menu/guide. The friendly staff will also try to help you as much as possible. Wonderful experience!!
Book yourself a session for the making, otherwise, simply order a drink and you will not regret it.

2885.a: Japan, 〒180-0004 Tokyo, Musashino, Kichijoji Honcho, 1 Chome−7−9 glänta kichijoji
2885.aj: 〒180-0004 東京都武蔵野市吉祥寺本町１丁目７−９ glänta kichijoji
catj: ファッション アクセサリー店
2885.ed: People say this ring-making workshop offers a fun and easy experience to create custom rings, with many design options for metal, shape, and finish. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the ability to complete a ring in about an hour. Visitors consistently praise the staff for being kind, patient, and providing clear, detailed instructions, often in English, making the process enjoyable…
2885.edj: この指輪作りワークショップは、カスタムリングを楽しく簡単に作れると評判です。金属の種類、形、仕上げなど、デザインの選択肢が豊富に用意されています。価格も手頃で、約1時間でリングを完成させられる点も特徴です。訪れた人からは、スタッフが親切で忍耐強く、英語での説明を含め、分かりやすく丁寧な指示をしてくれるため、初心者でも楽しめるという声が多く聞かれます。

rv.t: Was a super fun experience! I was scared at first but the employees walked us through the whole process and we ended up with 2 gorgeous handmade rings! Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting the Kichijoji area.

Cute spot to make custom couples rings. The cost of the ring depends on the material you choose, the size of your ring and the thickness that you want your ring to be. If you get silver the price is very reasonable. Gold is not as reasonable lol. I included the price chart. It’s supposed to take less than an hour but we took an hour and a half. Overall cute place.

It is a very special experience which I highly recommend to anyone who would like something unique from Tokyo, Japan. I was late for my appointment due to unforeseen circumstances and they were super friendly and helpful. Still accepted my appointment when I arrived. Though I emailed them to notify them in advance.

2886.a: Sahsya Kanetanaka, OAK OMOTESANDO 2F 3 Chome-6-1 Kita-Aoyama, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0061, Japan
2886.aj: 〒107-0061 東京都港区北青山３丁目６−１ OAK OMOTESANDO 2F 茶洒 金田中
2886.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious Japanese sweets like "mineoka tofu" and "ichigo daifuku," along with high-quality matcha and sencha. They also highlight the calm, quiet atmosphere and beautiful garden views, making it a great spot to relax. Other reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
2886.edj: 和食や和のスイーツをお茶や日本酒と共に堪能できる、洗練された和モダンな内装のカフェ。窓を全開して庭園を眺められる、開放的な空間。

rv.t: We had a great lunch. We had a multi-course meal including a lovely range of dishes. I really enjoyed the soup broths, sesame sauce on top of the turnip, and option to select the cold or hot noddles. The cold noodles were delicious. Loved the matcha with the dessert which was a lovely combo of bitter and sweet. Beautiful space designed with Hiroshi Sugimoto, whose photographs and art I love.
Fantastic location in Omotesando. Beautiful space looking over the internal garden. Felt safe - ideal for quite date nights or girls’ get together.

It’s a great spot to take a rest and chill if you are at Omotesando. Other cafes along the street are usually packed but this place is great as well. Food was okay, but what I care most is a nice place to sit down and take a breath. Good spot to take pictures too.

2887.a: 銀座やまう, 4 Chome-13-13 Ginza, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan
2887.aj: 〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座４丁目１３−１３ 銀座やまう
2887.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious Japanese-style desserts, such as matcha parfait and cream anmitsu, which are served with a variety of flavorful pickles. They also highlight the savory zosui and the high-quality tea and 100% fruit juice. Guests mention the quiet and relaxing atmosphere, making it a great spot to unwind.
2887.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、抹茶パフェやクリームあんみつといった和風のデザートが高く評価されています。これらのデザートには、風味豊かな漬物が添えられています。また、風味豊かな雑炊や、高品質な日本茶、100%のフルーツジュースもおすすめとして挙げられています。店内は静かでリラックスできる雰囲気で、くつろぐのに最適な場所という声が多くあります。

rv.t: A lovely find in Ginza! Tucked away on the 2nd floor, there is a small restaurant that offers delicious healthy meals. I had the rice porridge with mushrooms, which came with delicious pickles, desert, and tea. It was perfect for a cold day, and I was full afterwards. It seems like a popular place for lunch, and the day I visited there were a lot of chatty ladies so it was not very quiet, but still comfortable…

VERY quiet nice cafe above traditional Japanese pickles shop. The design of whole building is amazing and also their pickles and desserts are good. They don’t have much of varieties in the menu so check the menu outside before going in to see if they have something you want to try. Most importantly, everyone is kind of expected to stay very quiet inside, and not good for big group. Go there alone or with a friend…
Desserts featuring a variety of textures and the right amount of sweetness.

2888.a: Kantan-na Yume, 41-3 Kamiyamacho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0047, Japan
2888.aj: 〒150-0047 東京都渋谷区神山町４１−３ かんたんなゆめ
2888.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and beautifully reimagined wagashi, including nerikiri with unique fillings like Earl Grey bean paste, and a wide selection of teas and cocktails. They also highlight the cozy, enchanting atmosphere with soft neon lights, and the welcoming, patient staff. Guests mention it's a hidden gem, often less crowded than other places, making it ideal for a relaxing…
2888.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくて見た目も美しい、新感覚の和菓子が高く評価されています。アールグレイ餡のような珍しいフィリングの練り切りをはじめ、幅広い種類の和菓子が楽しめるようです。また、お茶やカクテルの種類も豊富という声もあります。店内は柔らかなネオンライトが灯る、居心地が良く魅力的な雰囲気で、スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応だと評判です。他の場所よりも混雑が少なく、リラックスして過ごせる隠れた名店だと感じる人も多いようです。

rv.t: I got the nerikiri for taking out as we already had multiple sweet treats. I wished i started out at this shop first so I could sit in and have the nerikiri with tea. The shop decor was cozy and welcoming, the staff was very pleasant and patient while I made my choice. The nerikiri was one of the best that I’ve had. The design is stunning. The bean that was used was of good quality and not too sweet. I find…

This cute little café it’s one of the few places in Tokyo open late, a real hidden gem. The matcha is truly exceptional and prepared with so much care. The sweets are a delight: traditional wagashi beautifully reimagined, delicious, with incredible combination of tastes and almost too pretty to eat.💖 The atmosphere is cozy and enchanting, with soft lights inside and outside that make the place feel special. The…

OMG, this place is incredible! I always thought you could only enjoy real traditional Japanese wagashi during tea ceremonies, so finding this place where you can taste them so freely truly feels like a dream 🥰 The wagashi were delicious, delicate and full of flavor. The welcome was wonderful and the place itself is beautiful and calming. A magical experience that I highly recommend!

2889.aj: 〒151-0051 東京都渋谷区千駄ケ谷１丁目１８−５ ヒューリック将棋会館千駄ヶ谷ビル 1階 棋の音Cafe

Visitors appreciate the unique shogi-themed merchandise and the opportunity to…
2889.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくてしっかりとした昔ながらのプリン、濃厚な抹茶バスクチーズケーキ、そして人気のカツカレーを含む風味豊かなカレー料理が高く評価されています。また、集中して作業したりリラックスしたりするのに理想的な、穏やかで静かな雰囲気が特徴で、一部のカウンター席やテーブル席では電源が利用できることも好評です。将棋をテーマにしたユニークなグッズや、隣接する道場で将棋の対局を観戦できる機会も、訪れた人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Surprisingly, this place prepares no food that is not microwaved even during lunchtime. It appears to be a kid’s menu only, with only curry and dessert available. The cheesecake was extraordinarily dry and the atmosphere was clinical. They make you take a humiliating sign with your order that states the maximum time for a stay is 60 minutes. I planned to stay more like 15, but the coffee was so scalding hot that I…
a very nice place to physically and mentally rest for a while after you got crushed in shogi by a elementary school kid repeatedly

The place has a calm focus the moment you sit down. Soft chatter, wooden boards clicking, people studying positions with the kind of attention that feels comforting rather than intense. It blends the feel of a quiet cafe with the rhythm of a small shogi or go club.

2890.a: Meguro Hiiragi Gakugei University East Exit, 伊津ビル 2 Chome-8-23 Takaban, Meguro City, Tokyo 152-0004, Japan
2890.aj: 〒152-0004 東京都目黒区鷹番２丁目８−２３ 伊津ビル 目黒ひいらぎ 学芸大学東口店
2890.ed: Diners like this cafe's taiyaki, noting its thin, crispy skin and perfectly sweet, abundant red bean paste. They also highlight the clean, comfortable atmosphere, making it ideal for a quiet break or dessert. Guests mention the excellent value, especially for sets that include taiyaki and tea.
2890.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、たい焼きが高く評価されています。薄くてパリッとした皮と、上品な甘さのつぶあんがたっぷり入っている点が特徴のようです。また、店内は清潔感があり、落ち着いた雰囲気で、静かに休憩したい時やデザートを楽しむのに最適という声もあります。たい焼きとお茶のセットは特にコストパフォーマンスが良いと評判です。

rv.t: Very good takayaki! Its nice, crispy and the bean sweetness is just right and perfect. It isn’t overly sweet therefore you taste a good balance of flavors. Highly recommended and will come again!
Very very good taiyaki shop! Taiyaki here are moderately sweet, with nice crispy outer part. They are also naturally vegan, with no dairy and eggs used

かき氷 (kakigoori) is delicious and the space is cozy and stylish! Tip: It’s 1 order per person and the shaved ice portions are pretty large, so if you have 2 people you can order 1 shaved ice to share and another drink 😊 (like coffee)!

2891.a: Otonari Coffee, 2F 2 Chome-48 Kanda Jinbocho, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 101-0051, Japan
2891.aj: 〒101-0051 東京都千代田区神田神保町２丁目４８ 2F オトナリ珈琲
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2891.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious specialty coffee and homemade desserts like pudding and cheesecake, all within a cozy, retro, and peaceful hidden atmosphere. Other reviews mention the entrance can be difficult to find and it can be crowded.
2891.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、おいしいスペシャルティコーヒーと、プリンやチーズケーキなどの自家製デザートが楽しめると評判です。店内は居心地の良いレトロな雰囲気で、隠れ家のような落ち着いた空間が高く評価されています。 一方で、入り口が分かりにくいという声や、混雑していることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Absolute hidden gem in the city of Tokyo. We accidentally found this one by exploring the area during NYE period. Despite the 90 mins long queueing, the dining experience and the taste was to die for. Very authentic. Also the vibe that gave was fantastic. Either you wanna go solo or with a few friends, this is definitely worth checking. Oh…and reasonable pricing too. The barista girl was very welcoming. What more…

Incredible environment, great ☕️ and great 🍮. This is really great 雰囲気 and not ruined by foreigners beelining to popular, high reviewed places like Glitch. Yuki-san was kind enough to recommend me some of her favourite cafés around Tokyo. Check out their website for interviews with great coffee roasters all over Japan. Hope I can come back soon!

They specifically requested customers to rate them one star. It’s located above an old laundromat, the entrance was a bit difficult to find. There was a line and we waited for about 20 minutes. There are handwritten notes and newsletter from the staffs to browse through while waiting. There were mostly locals. The staffs were all kind and welcoming.

2892.a: ringram, 原宿Mitte A棟 4 Chome-26-3 Jingumae, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0001, Japan
2892.aj: 〒150-0001 東京都渋谷区神宮前４丁目２６−３ 原宿Mitte A棟 ringram 表参道店
2892.ed: People say this workshop offers a fun and unique experience to create personalized rings, with many design and material options available. Visitors highlight the reasonable prices and the ability to take home rings on the same day. They also praise the staff for being friendly, patient, and providing clear, helpful instructions in English.
2892.edj: このワークショップを利用した人からは、自分だけの指輪を作れる、楽しくて特別な体験ができると評判です。デザインや素材の選択肢が豊富に用意されているようです。また、手頃な価格で、作った指輪をその日のうちに持ち帰れる点が評価されています。スタッフは親しみやすく、忍耐強く、英語で分かりやすく丁寧な説明をしてくれるという声も多く聞かれます。

rv.t: We visited Ringram Omotesando last Saturday to make our wedding rings for our wedding in Tokyo! We chose the pairing anniversary option package and made two rings using K10 White Gold. We had an absolutely amazing time throughout this experience! It was so fun getting to create the ring from scratch and choosing how we wanted the rings to look. My husband went for a hammered effect 5mm ring and I went for the mosaic…

We made an appointment and arrived on time and were immediately welcomed in and taken up stairs. We were introduced to our "ring expert/guider", her name is Hana! She was so sweet and patient, she guided us through the steps to carefully select the rings that we would be happy with (metal, size, design). The create the ring process took us around almost 2 hours and honestly I was nervous about making the design…

My husband and I made our wedding bands at Ringram Omotesando, and it was such a wonderful experience! Our instructor, Hanna was kind, patient, and explained each step clearly, making the process easy to follow. I especially appreciated that she reviewed the package we had selected when we made our online reservation and helped us make the appropriate changes before we started. She was incredibly supportive and…

rv.t: We waited for an hour and 20 minutes before it was our turn – the longest I’ve ever waited for food in my life – but it was worth it. If you enjoy tempura prepared in the traditional way that hasn’t changed for generations, this is the place for you. There weren’t any tourists either in the line or in the restaurant. The food was excellent, I highly recommend it. Nobody in the restaurant spoke English, but ChatGPT…

We just reached Tokyo & randomly came across this restaurant while searching for places to eat near our airbnb, and damn we were so lucky!!! The tempura was amazing, and the portion so big. We thankfully didn’t have to wait long, perhaps just 15 mins, as it was already almost 2pm. Definitely coming back here!!

What a great ancient Tempura place! Delicious ten don and many combination to choose from. If you like tempura, this is the place to try out. The wait is a bit longer than usual restaurant. For those food hunter, I am certain that you would find the wait worth awhile. One last thing, the dessert is a pleasant surprise 😀

2894.aj: 〒101-0041 東京都千代田区神田須田町１丁目１３ 神田まつや 本店
2894.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious handmade soba, especially the tempura soba with large, crispy shrimp, and the flavorful dipping sauce. They also highlight the traditional, lively atmosphere of the historic building and the friendly, efficient service. Many mention it's a great spot for a quick, authentic meal, but note it's cash only.
2894.edj: 純和風の風情がある店内は、気さくで庶民的な雰囲気。石臼挽き粉を使用する手打ち蕎麦と丼メニューの他、つまみやアルコールも提供する。

rv.t: Nice plain cold fresh Soba with side order of juicy yakitori chicken but nothing spectacular or memorable. We arrived at 1030 (opens at 11) and were 2nd in line. By 1045 there was a long line already. It’s a very traditional Japanese restaurant, and it was more a local place where Japanese people actually go to. Recommended if you want local experience!! We were actually the only tourist!!

Food: Kanda Matsuya felt like one of those places where the simplest thing on the table tells you immediately why it has lasted so long. The soba was outstanding. Clean, fragrant, and just textured enough to make every bite feel deliberate without turning rustic for the sake of it. It had that exact kind of restraint that makes great soba so satisfying. Nothing flashy, just noodles with real character and a dipping…

You have to be here early about 1030 if you want to be in the first batch. The line gets long by 1040 and the shop only opens at 1100. It’s crowded but the line moves fast! The Soba was good, but nothing spectacular. The hot soba was a little too salty though. The yakitori was good though. A very beautiful shop with a calm and relaxing atmosphere. Payment cash only.

rv.t: The coffee is adequate but the food is pretty good. However the biggest issue is the size of the cafe. It is incredibly small, and you are not permitted to queue because of the location. So if you don't have a reservation then your chance of getting a seat is pretty much the luck of the draw.

Reserved a couple weeks in advance online. Service was good. Their house signature egg sandwich was sold out by 10am so I ordered the second egg sandwich which was delicious. Coffee pudding was also good. I wish the Russian coffee had a more distinct espresso flavor.

Kayaba Coffee is a lovely corner spot with a vintage feel, featuring traditional tatami seating on the top floor and relaxing jazz music in the background. It’s very popular with tourists, yet the staff remain incredibly accommodating to walk-ins, friendly, and fluent in English. We had the Hashed Beef - savoury and rich, like a beef stroganoff without the sour cream (you can also get it with the soft omelette) , An…

2896.aj: 〒111-0051 東京都台東区蔵前３丁目１３−４ BARK BAKE & ROAST
2896.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including pour-overs and lattes, along with freshly baked croissants and a variety of pastries. They also highlight the dog-friendly atmosphere, the beautiful views of the shrine, and the friendly, welcoming staff. Other reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
2896.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ハンドドリップやラテなどのおいしいコーヒーに加え、焼きたてのクロワッサンや様々な種類のパンが提供されていると評判です。また、犬同伴が可能な雰囲気や、神社が見える美しい景色、親しみやすいスタッフも高く評価されています。 一方で、スタッフの対応が行き届いていないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: We came across this café while visiting a nearby temple and decided to stop by—and we’re so glad we did. The place has a very aesthetic vibe, with a calm and thoughtfully designed interior that makes it perfect for a relaxing break. The coffee was good, but the best was the croissant bark roll: absolutely amazing—definitely worth trying. In terms of price, we paid around €18 for two cappuccinos, a slice of cake, and…

Absolutely delicious coffee and cakes, very professional and kind staff. They roast the coffee in house, offer a wide variety of beans, including honey-processed ones. The coffee can be made as pour over. I think it's definitely worth a little waiting time. All coffee comes with information on taste and origin. You can sit inside or in front of the cafe on fresh air and look at the cherry blossoms above the Kuramae…

Clean, industrial and modern. Nice ambiance. Had the eggs Benedict, cinnamon roll, and a Brazilian pour-over coffee. Minus one star for the eggs benedict. The poached egg was cooked through, so no yolk porn to share. The croissant bread tasted a little stale. Coffee was well prepared and had all the taste notes as described.

2897.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including a special blend, and tasty baked goods like classic cheesecake and moist, crispy scones. Guests also highlight the beautiful, thoughtfully designed space with a serene, antique, and rustic atmosphere. Other reviews mention the staff can be unhelpful.
2897.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、特別なブレンドコーヒーや、クラシックなチーズケーキ、しっとりサクサクのスコーンといった焼き菓子が美味しいと評価しています。また、店内は静かでアンティーク調の素朴な雰囲気があり、美しく考え抜かれた空間であるという声が多くあります。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Such a cool and rustic atmosphere. It is a real hidden gem where the coffee is tasty and the vibe is perfect. The owner is clearly passionate about his craft which makes the experience even better. Highly recommend!

Good decoration and sense of space usage. Bad vibe and services. Instead of warm and gentle outlook, the overall atmosphere is rather unfriendly, unsettled due to rather cold attitude from staffs and rules. Little disappointed as this could be one my best cafe, I ever visited.
Cute little cafe behind asakusa unfriendly staff good cake lovely vibes 1st floor: furniture and clothing store, can order and pay here 2nd floor: seating area Overall love it except the service part

catj: アンティークショップ
2898.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious seasonal pasta, flavorful curries, and fluffy cakes. They also highlight the calm and intimate atmosphere, surrounded by antique furniture and plants. Guests mention the staff are kind and provide warm service.
2898.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しい季節のパスタ、風味豊かなカレー、ふわふわのケーキが高く評価されています。また、アンティーク家具や植物に囲まれた、落ち着いたアットホームな雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフは親切で温かいサービスを提供しているという声が多くあります。

rv.t: One of my favourite cafés from this Tokyo trip. The service was warm and kind - the lady who served me was so pleasant and gentle. I don’t usually go for fruit cakes, but she recommended their blackcurrant Victoria cake, and it turned out to be one of the best cake I’ve ever had. The light meringue on top pairs beautifully with the naturally sweet jam and soft, fluffy sponge. It was lovely! Even the tableware was…
Stopped in here for lunch today. Vegetable curry and avocado toast were delicious. Really charming and great atmosphere.

What a beautiful place to visit. Great recommendation to try homemade lemon cake that was the best I've ever had. Homely feel with a beautiful antique shop downstairs. A must visit while in tokyo. Thank you for making my time visiting your beautiful city that much more special. With love from Ireland 🇮🇪

catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店

rv.t: 木の香りが落ち着くカフェでした。 入店時に、注文お会計してから、 席に座りお食事させてもらいました。 麹味噌を使ったソース（？）も、美味しかったです。 STEAMパンは、ふっわふわで、もちもち感もあり、また食べたいです。

扉を開けた瞬間、その美しさに心を奪われました。 古い建物の趣を大切にしながら、現代的なセンスが融合した「喫茶トアル」。 今回は食事の後だったのでチャイをいただきましたが、立ちのぼるスパイシーな香りと、この居心地の良さに、思わず時間を忘れてしまいました。 名物は蒸籠蒸しのパンと野菜とのこと。 これほど素敵な空間なら、次はぜひお腹を空かせて、食事を目的に再訪したいと思います。 あまりに居心地が良すぎて、お店の回転が悪くならないかこちらが心配してしまうほど、深くリラックスできる名店です。

インスタで見つけてずっと気になっていました。2025年4月上旬平日、ランチタイムに初訪問。古民家カフェで外観も店内も雰囲気を感じる。特に店内はおしゃれに飾られていて良い雰囲気。 入店してすぐにレジで注文、お会計が済んだら席に案内される。お水はセルフ。カウンター席、テーブル席、ソファ席があった。 ちまきセットを注文。やや待ちがあるかなと思ったけどおしゃべりしてればあっという間。 なんでか蒸籠の蓋を開ける時わくわくする。蓋を開けると彩りよく野菜が入っていて大きく湯気が出てとても美味しそう。自家製胡麻マヨソースがめちゃうまだった。ちまきも熱々、味も濃いめで美味しかった。小皿のオイルがかかったプチトマト、おいしくてもっと食べたかった。ボリュームも丁度良かった。…

2901.ed: People say this restaurant's jinenjo dishes, including jinenjo tororo and jinenjo steak, are delicious and satisfying, with many appreciating the flavorful seasonings and sticky texture. They also highlight the convenient parking, quick service, and the option to order via tablet. Other reviews mention the atmosphere can be unappealing.
2901.edj: クチコミによると、このレストランの自然薯料理は、自然薯とろろや自然薯ステーキなど、どれも美味しくて満足度が高いと評判です。味付けの良さや粘り気のある食感を評価する声が多くあります。また、駐車場が利用しやすい点、料理の提供が早い点、タブレットで注文できる点も好評です。 一方で、店の雰囲気が良くないという意見もあります。

rv.t: We had a really memorable meal at this spot. The host was amazing — warm, polite, and so passionate when explaining everything to us. It felt like they genuinely cared about us enjoying the experience. Each table had free matcha on tap, which was a lovely touch (great for a refreshing sip between bites). We also ordered using a tablet right at the table — super easy and convenient — and our food showed up through a…

Visiting the Yamaimo (Japanese mountain yam) restaurant provided an intriguing blend of culinary excellence and unique decor that might not resonate with everyone at first glance. The interior, which could be described as "retro" by some, initially gives off an impression that might not align with contemporary tastes, potentially appearing outdated to the modern diner. This particular aesthetic choice, however…

Yam sets come in a conveyor belt!!! But I think the taste is not as good as the old shop. Maybe the scenery in the old shop helps with the appetite! Also the size of rice has to be decided at the beginning. Unlike in the old shop, the rice came in a container that kept the heat and we could get more rice if needed. Parking is easier in this new shop though.

2902.ed: Artisanal regional desserts & green tea in a tranquil cafe surrounded by a garden & a bamboo forest.
2902.edj: 庭や竹林に囲まれた閑静な敷地にある甘味処。職人技が光る和菓子と緑茶を味わえる。

rv.t: We visited Toraya Kobo Gotemba in early March and it was a lovely experience, especially after exploring the nearby Former Kishi Residence. The café is located within a garden setting, making it a perfect stop to relax while heading back from the residence. The overall aesthetic is beautiful, with a wooden design that feels very warm and traditional. The seating area is spacious and can accommodate a good number of…

You can enjoy traditional Japanese sweets from Toraya. There’s also a spacious garden where you can relax with a cup of green tea while savoring sweets or light snacks. Since there aren’t many young people around, it’s a quiet spot. It might be just the place to unwind when you’re in Gotemba.

A 500-Year Legacy: The Ultimate Dorayaki Experience in the Snow 🇯🇵✨ If you are looking for a taste of living history, this legendary confectionery is an absolute must-visit. Steeped in over 500 years of tradition, it offers more than just sweets—it offers a journey back in time. 🥞 The Legendary Dorayaki The star of the show is, without a doubt, the Dorayaki. You can truly taste the centuries of refinement in every…

rv.t: One of the famous convience store in Japan. They sell many type of good: like chocolate, candy, fresh food,… The price is comparable.
Although it’s not a large supermarket, it provides various items. It’s convenient for tourists who stay in Prince Hotel or Toyoko Inn.

sometimes i vexed there isn't any convenient store nearby, but here solved the problem. it's a small supermarket that supply the basic need - water, tea, soft drinks, beer and snack. even more it has prepared food, fruits and vegetables. good to see it's open on the high street and very easy to access. it'd be good if it opens till midnight.

2904.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious pancakes and French toast, along with a variety of other tasty food options like avocado toast and curry. They also highlight the reasonable prices for sets and the bright, open atmosphere. Guests mention the convenient QR code ordering system and the friendly, attentive staff.
2904.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいパンケーキやフレンチトーストが評判のようです。アボカドトーストやカレーなど、他にも様々な美味しい食事が提供されているという声が多くあります。セットメニューは手頃な価格で、店内は明るく開放的な雰囲気も特徴です。また、QRコードを使った便利な注文システムや、親切で気の利くスタッフも高く評価されています。

rv.t: Looking for a spot to take break and enjoy a cup of coffee with some light food. Tried scone, basque cheese cake,pancake meal set with black coffee and latte. Coffee are average. The scone are buttery and smell nice. The basque cheese cake inside is soft but the flavor is not rich enough. A very convenient spot near metro and garden for a quick stop.

A cafe out of busy main Tokyo area 😙 They got both French toast and pancakes 🥞 so why not both? Noon visit on Friday - completely full 😅 Water pitcher nearby 800 pancakes 400 French toast add on 500 for ice coffee Set available for the pancake / French toast plate at around 1800 There is a large table in the middle you 6 seats so if you area solo you’ll prob get sat there You get a lot of butter 🧈 Pancakes 🥞 - they…

One of the worst pancake I’ve ever had in my life. It tasted so bitter, I couldn’t even feel any other flavors. Even the caramelized banana was so bad, it didn’t help the taste at all:( My latte’s milk was also burnt, it tasted so bad. I was so excited to visit since some people left good comments but I will never come again😭

2905.a: Japan, 〒350-0063 Saitama, Kawagoe, Saiwaicho, 2−3 2F 時越郵便
2905.aj: 〒350-0063 埼玉県川越市幸町2−３ 2F 時越郵便

rv.t: 時が人を結ぶまち川越にある不思議な郵便屋さん。 お店の奥にある古い郵便ポストがあり、そこに手紙を投函する​と一年後の自分に手紙が届く「手紙のタイムカプセル」 3階には本格的な写真館があり、そこで撮影した写真を入れることもできます 素敵です
1年前の手紙が届きました。 残念ながら1年前とは状況が変わっており、その中で手紙は来て、届いてしまうことに少々ソワソワしていたのですが、店主の方からのお手紙も1枚同封されていて、その素敵なメッセージに心が温かくなりました。1年の時を超えてに自分自身の環境の変化や成長に思いを馳せることが出来る素晴らしいお店です。お世話になりました。また機会があれば、よろしくお願いいたします。
本日、ご利用させていただきました。 当主さんがとても素晴らしい方で幸せな時間を彼女と過ごせました。 上階で写真まで撮ってもらい（無料で）感謝しかありません。 一年後、今日書いた手紙が届く事とても楽しみです。 ありがとうございました。

2906.aj: 〒678-0091 兵庫県相生市矢野町瓜生桔梗隼光鍛刀場｜日本刀制作・小刀づくり体験 羅漢口24

rv.t: You're not just here to watch and learn, you will have time to operate a forge. Hayamitsu San will walk you through all the steps in a welcome atmosphere. This was an amazing, intimate experience. Kids can participate as well, as my son (10y) also participated as I had reserved 2 spots. A great experience.

My wife suprised me on our honeymoon bc she knew how much I want to try forging a knife/sword. Meeting & learning from Hayamitsu was one of the highlights of my life. A truly magical experience. The location and tranquility reminded me of some of the best gardens we’ve explored throughout Japan! On top of that we had our first experience forging with equipment that is no longer used or even available. The kiln is…

Amazing! We made great looking and sharp small knives with engraving and a leather sheath of our choice. The instructions were clear and good and he helped us correct our mistakes and polish the blade. He was also very nice and explained the process in an easily digestible way! Be aware that the English explanations are mostly via Google translate but it worked out really well.

2907.a: Asakusa Gyukatsu, 雷門上村ビル 1F・B1F 2 Chome-17-10 Kaminarimon, Taito City, Tokyo 111-0034, Japan
2907.aj: 〒111-0034 東京都台東区雷門２丁目１７−１０ 雷門上村ビル 1F・B1F 浅草 牛かつ
2907.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious gyukatsu, which is served rare with a hot stone grill for cooking to personal preference, along with a variety of flavorful sauces and sides. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the cozy, authentic atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are very friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service, often explaining the menu and cooking process.
2907.edj: このお店を利用した人は、美味しい牛カツを高く評価しています。牛カツはレアな状態で提供され、熱い石のグリルで好みに合わせて焼くことができ、様々な風味豊かなソースやサイドメニューが添えられています。手頃な価格と居心地の良い本格的な雰囲気も特徴です。スタッフはとても親切で気配りができ、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているというクチコミが多く、メニューや調理方法を説明してくれることもよくあるようです。

rv.t: One of the best beef cutlets I’ve ever had! 🍱 We went there around 3pm and still had to wait for 30–45 mins but it was totally worth it! We ordered one small and one medium size. Once we got inside, the food was already served. So efficient! The beef cutlets were very tender, soft and delicious. The portions were also very generous. Depending on your preference, you can grill it for as little as 2s or more than 5s…

This cozy restaurant, with its limited seating, was our second attempt after a long wait during our first visit. We were prepared to wait over 30 minutes this time, but the experience was well worth it. The beef was served with a beautifully browned exterior while maintaining a slightly raw center. The meat was expected to be cooked over a hot iron plate, and the provided condiments perfectly complemented the beef…

Another awesome dish to add to my list of favorite foods in Japan—gyukatsu. The name pretty much says it all if you know a bit of Japanese: gyu means beef, and katsu usually refers to something fried. The twist here is that the gyukatsu isn’t fully cooked when it’s served. It comes rare, and you’re given a small hot stone to cook the meat yourself. How cool is that? It’s also served with three types of sauce…

2908.a: Angel Road, 24-92 Ko, Tonosho, Shozu District, Kagawa 761-4101, Japan

2908.ed: Picturesque locale with a chain of islands connected by a walkable sandbar that appears at low tide.
2908.edj: 干潮時に現れる細長い砂州の道が、沖合に連なる小島を結ぶ風光明媚な観光スポット。

rv.t: This is a tomulo that you can cross with your beloved to make a wish and tie it to a geographical feature of the nearest island. It was surprisingly uncrossed when we went but I did notice a great many Koreans and local Japanese couples. There was also a dead cuttlefish on the shore. It is a peaceful and romantic escape for you and your lover and it will provide memories of your trip to this pastoral part of Japan.

It's a unique experience, waiting for the tide to wash away at sunset so you can walk on the sandbar. The sunset was lovely. We went in November and it was already quite cold. Wear waterproof shoes so you can run across. The tide doesn't always wash away 100% in the evenings so it's a hit or miss. But it's still a beautiful place. Very romantic. It can get pretty crowded too
It's a place with a rich history and beautiful romance. If you plan to go, be sure to check the high and low tide times so you can walk across to the island.

rv.t: For just 600¥ you can design and create your own scarf, this is now my most prized possession 🙏 The staff will give you very clear instructions, and you can visit the museum afterwards. This was a 10/10 experience, I loved it so much! 😭❤️

A fun activity to do when visiting Wakayama. It was so worth it, we can design woll coaster, scarf, of pillow case, the price and the time to make depends on the item we choose. Staff were friendly and helpful with one man could help us with english.

I had a really great experience here. As others mentioned, there is a limit of how many people can do it per day. I arrived 30-40 mins before opening and there were already about 3 groups in front of me. Eventually, the staff member comes before opening to give everyone a number. I was in and out by 11 but my design was simple. Although he did not speak English (which is understandable, it is my fault for not…

2910.aj: 〒144-0041 東京都大田区羽田空港２丁目７−１ 羽田エアポートガーデン 1階 五代目 花山うどん 羽田エアポートガーデン店
2910.ed: Diners like this restaurant's unique, wide, and chewy Himokawa udon noodles, which are served with two delicious dipping sauces. They also highlight the crispy tempura and the variety of side dishes, including grilled buns and mushroom tempura. Guests mention the friendly and attentive staff, the clean atmosphere, and the convenience of QR code ordering.
2910.edj: このうどん店を利用した人は、幅が広くてもちもちとした食感が特徴の「鬼ひも川うどん」を高く評価しています。2種類のつけ汁で味の変化を楽しめる点も好評です。サクサクとした天ぷらや、焼きまんじゅう、舞茸の天ぷらなど、サイドメニューの豊富さも魅力のようです。店内の雰囲気は明るく清潔感があり、スタッフは親切で丁寧な対応だと評価されています。QRコードでの注文も便利という声があります。

rv.t: First day in Tokyo Haneda, had dinner here. Very delicious flat udon. I ordered the hot soya soup base flat udon, the soup taste good. My sis ordered the cold noodles with 2 sauces. Very delicious too. But I prefer the hot soya soup base. Worth trying from Singapore 14 May 2026 evening.

This is the same brand as the one in Ginza! So skip the queue over there and come here if you’re in Haneda airport. It taste just as good! We came at about 11:15AM when it’s just opened and it was full house already, waited for about 10 minutes for our table. You’ve an option to go for the cold Himokawa noodles or the hot Himokawa noodles. We went for both. If you’re a soupy person, I’d recommend going for the hot…

I’d rate this place 3.5 out of 5. It’s the same chain as the one in Ginza and is quite convenient if you’re flying from Haneda Airport. The udon is nicely chewy, while the tempura is just average. I went after the lunch rush but still had to wait about 20 minutes to get a seat. As others have said, it’s worth trying if there’s no queue. #udon

2911.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious, generously portioned sandwiches and flavorful drip coffee, with several bean varieties available. They also highlight the peaceful, cozy atmosphere, making it a great escape from city noise. Guests mention the friendly, attentive staff and appreciate the English menu and early opening hours.
2911.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ボリュームたっぷりの美味しいサンドイッチや、数種類の豆から選べる風味豊かなドリップコーヒーが高く評価されています。都会の喧騒から離れた、穏やかで居心地の良い雰囲気も特徴のようです。また、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフの対応や、英語のメニューがあること、そして早い時間から営業している点も好評です。

rv.t: i mean, just look at that sandwich. u know its 5 stars from that alone. was as good as it looks. coffee was also very good. interior is modern, classy and clean and spacious. prices normal. older couple running the place were friendly and efficient. located on a side street.
Delicious!! The coffee smell so nice roasted and satisfying. The owner are so kind and welcoming. We came with our toddler and she's happy

Appears to be a husband and wife business. The menu is simple so are the foods and drinks offered, looks like it's extremely popular even though it's out of the way . We had a family breakfast in here which was great . Too bad you can't pay with anything but cash .

2912.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Italian offerings, especially the juicy harami steak and the unique, interactive flaming Parmesan gnocchi. They also highlight the cave-themed private rooms and dim lighting, creating a fantastic, immersive atmosphere perfect for special occasions. Many guests mention the staff are friendly and attentive, providing excellent service.
2912.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、美味しいイタリア料理を高く評価しています。特に、ジューシーなハラミステーキや、目の前で炎が上がる演出が楽しいパルミジャーノニョッキが評判のようです。洞窟をイメージした個室や薄暗い照明が、特別な日にぴったりの素晴らしい没入感のある雰囲気を作り出しているという声が多くあります。また、スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかなサービスを提供しているというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Very good

町田駅から徒歩1分。 洞窟のような非日常空間で食事を楽しめる個室ダイニング『HORaANA』へ。 駅前ビル2階にありながら、一歩入ると照明を落とした洞窟風の内装が広がるユニークなお店。 石壁調の個室が並び、デートや女子会でも使いやすく落ち着いた雰囲気が魅力。 洞窟をより感じたい方は個室での食事がおすすめ。 カクテルやサングリアなどドリンクも豊富で、食事だけでなく雰囲気を楽しむ店としての満足度が高く、料理は鮮魚や揚げ物、火を使ったパフォーマンスなど楽しめるメニューが揃ってる。 町田でゆったり食事を楽しみたい方や雰囲気重視のデートや女子会にもおすすめなお店。

いただいたメニュー ファンタジーコース ・前菜5種盛り合わせ ・カルパッチョ ・HORaANA特製ミニハンバーガー ・オニオングラタンスープ ・ハラミステーキ マッシュポテトサラダ付 ・HORaANA特製ニョッキ ・紅茶のアフォガード 洞窟のような半個室で食事を楽しめる、新感覚のダイニング。 店内はおしゃれで、まるで童話の物語の中にいるような雰囲気があり、料理だけでなく空間も楽しめるお店でした。 前菜5種盛り合わせは見た目も可愛く、どれも美味しかったです。コースの最初から気分が上がる一皿でした。 カルパッチョは鯛の旨みを感じられる一品。 HORaANA特製ミニハンバーガーは、小さいながらもきちんと作られていて、コースの中に出てくると嬉しい料理でした。 オニオングラタンスープは濃すぎず、個人的に好みの優しい味。玉ねぎの深みも感じられました。 ハラミステーキは柔らかく、マッシュポテトサラダが付いているのも嬉しかったです。…

rv.t: Oshino Hakkai was easily the highlight of our Mt. Fuji day trip. While there are plenty of places to admire Japan's most famous mountain, this was the one that truly felt special. The village has a peaceful, old-Japan charm with traditional houses, wooden bridges and crystal-clear streams flowing throughout. At its heart are the famous eight spring-fed ponds, whose water comes from snow that falls on Mt. Fuji and…

A visit to Oshino Hakkai is a beautiful and unique experience, offering crystal-clear spring ponds, traditional thatched-roof houses, and stunning views of Mount Fuji in the distance. The water is incredibly clear and the whole village feels like a step back in time, with a calm and traditional atmosphere. However, it can get quite crowded, especially during peak hours and tour bus times, which takes away a bit from…

This is a wonderful addition to any trip to Fujiyama - especially if the weather is a little unpredictable (which it often is). Plenty of beautiful traditional buildings and some of the clearest ponds I have ever seen. Transport is easy by bus. We travelled from Shinjuku station, which was quick, pleasant and cheaper than the train. (You can book tickets online.) Enjoyed the food stalls on the way and at the…

rv.t: It’s not so easy to find this restaurant. Its is on 3rd floor, not so sure about the building name and also the name of the restaurant is written on a small sticker at the entrance of building 1F. Even after teaching 3rd floor you need to ring the bell and not all the restaurant ambience. A bit small not so happening place but it’s ok to spend time with some good friends and talk, not recommending for families or…
Amazing experience! We could not love more the food and the attention from the team!!! Difficult to find but impossible to miss!!
Highly recommend to come here !

Amazing appetiser that was smoked. Ordered 3 rounds of the carpaccio, loved the beef sushi and found the chicken Vientiane interesting (slight spice). 2916.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and carefully prepared pasta dishes, seasonal parfaits, and popular muffins, with many highlighting the flavorful homemade carrot dressing. rv.t: The café is not far from Castle ruins. I had the plate lunch set with many little tastes to enjoy, plus some rice flour muffins to go. While there weren’t many lunch options, the lunch was highly curated and delicious. They take a lot of care to make a fine menu. The muffin selections were very creative - Belgian chocolate with nuts and rosemary, match/anko/butter, savory vegetable, lemon or chai (however the menu…
Small comfortable place with good food 😋 They found out I was walking exploring on a hot day and brought me so much water even though I didn't ask 😊

古民家を活かした雰囲気のあるカフェで、店内はとてもおしゃれ。落ち着いた空間でゆったりと過ごせます。 お料理はどれも丁寧に作られていて美味しく、毎回満足度の高い内容です。 フォカッチャやサラダのドレッシングはテイクアウトできることもあり、見かけた際には必ず購入しています。 マフィンやケーキも魅力的なものばかりで、店内で楽しむだけでなく、ついテイクアウトもしてしまうほどです。 そして何より印象的なのが、店員さんの丁寧で温かい接客。居心地の良さは、この心配りによるものだと感じます。接客の良さに惹かれて足を運びたくなるお店です。 価格はやや高めに感じるかもしれませんが、それに見合うだけの味・雰囲気・サービスが揃っており、十分に価値のある時間を過ごせます。

2917.aj: 〒285-0009 千葉県佐倉市飯野町２７ 印旛沼サンセットヒルズ

rv.t: It’s a great camp area, costs ¥4000 for a night (2 people), with areas separated for each group. The sunset is said to be beautiful. I didn’t see it because I was too focused on the steak I was cooking. Areas B, 1, 7, 9, were the best places to view the sunset while being at your tent. The place is more of a first come first serve since you can’t book a specific area, just reserve a place to be able to book. Pets…

Organized camping ground. There are at least 34 slots and each are spacious enough for tent, tarp and car. There is also one table available per slot. You can make reservation to camp but the ground slot is first come, first serve basis. Check in is from 11am-3pm and check out is at 10:30am. There is a washing area, toilet for men and women. They sell wood for 1,000 yen per bucket (you can fill the bucket as much as…

Great place for camping. You can book three days in advance. They have all the equipments for BBQ and you can also make pizza on hot rocks. There's a place to enjoy a hot coffee while enjoying sunset. Didn't like the owner's behaviour though. He sounds rude and doesn't even listen to any inquiry properly.

2918.aj: 〒297-0123 千葉県長生郡長南町蔵持１０３８ 芳泉茶寮

rv.t: Cute vegetarian cafe restaurant which converted old house at quiet village. Especially recommend for meditators because the owner couple is Vipassana teacher. You can also buy some sime handmade original products made by them.

2025年1月30日に【旧正月ランチ】で訪問しました。 素人目に見てもひとつひとつの料理が丁寧に作られていることがわかり、食事していて幸せな気持ちになりました。 【旧正月ランチ】は中国のいろいろな地方で旧正月に食べられているメニューとのことでしたが、「はじめて体験する味」がたくさんあり、一般的な中華とはまったくジャンルの異なる味で満足度もとても高かったです。 築160年の古民家の雰囲気はすばらしいですし、オーナーのおふたりの温かいお人柄が作り出している店内のゆったりした雰囲気が、お料理をさらに美味しくしてくれています。 贅沢なひとときを過ごさせていただきました。 ランチ営業している日は少ないと思いますが、タイミングが合えばぜひ行ってみてください。 なお、お土産で購入できる、辣油や山椒油、パイナップルケーキや杏仁おからのパウンドケーキなども絶品です！

八兵衛珈琲店主に紹介されて、芳泉茶寮さんでランチ。 百年以上の古民家で中国茶をゆったりと。 ランチは店主オススメのタケノコドリア。 タケノコを一番美味しく食べる料理のひとつとおっしゃるだけあり、濃厚なチーズに負けないタケノコの香りと歯ごたえ。旨い。 お茶も6〜7煎は飲めるとのことで、煎じる毎に時間を延ばして味を楽しむ。 とてもわかりづらい場所にあるうえ、営業も不定期だが、良い雰囲気と美味しいお茶と食事を楽しめた。

2919.a: Black Cat Coffeehouse, 327 Daida, Mobara, Chiba 297-0044, Japan

2919.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and satisfying lunch plates, which feature a rotating selection of main dishes and healthy ingredients. They also highlight the charming, renovated traditional house atmosphere with unique decor and cat-themed items. Guests mention the convenient payment options, including card, cash, and PayPay.
2919.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、日替わりのメイン料理と健康的な食材を使った、美味しくて満足感のあるランチプレートが高く評価されています。また、趣のある古民家を改装した魅力的な雰囲気や、個性的な装飾、猫をテーマにしたアイテムも特徴です。支払い方法については、カード、現金、PayPayが利用できるため便利という声もあります。

rv.t: Love this place. Perfect place to unwind and relax

ざ・古民家カフェ。人気のようで少し待ちました。 駐車場は8台ぐらい停められました。 店内も店員さんもとてもゆったり時間が流れています。入り口に注意書きがあるように提供スピードはかなりゆったり。時間に余裕がある人におすすめ。 お料理はランチプレートで選んだメインにデリとターメリックライスが付いてきました。どのお料理もとても美味しかったです。ただし、メインは熱々だともっと美味しく食べられそうだなと感じました。
こちらは2年前に行った時の写真です。 東京から移住したご夫婦が空き家を改装した オシャレカフェです。 ・こちらのランチはメインを2種類から選ぶ プレートランチ。 どれも絶品！！でした。 ・季節限定のあじさいのケーキもめちゃくちゃ可愛い ・お店のインテリアも素敵でした。

catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2925.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious set meals, especially the flavorful grilled mackerel, steamed organic vegetables, and hearty fermented enzyme brown rice. They also highlight the charming, tranquil atmosphere of the renovated traditional Japanese house. Guests mention the cafe is a perfect spot for a relaxing meal, with many appreciating the healthy and carefully prepared dishes.
2925.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しい定食が高く評価されています。特に、脂の乗った風味豊かな焼き鯖、有機野菜のせいろ蒸し、そして発酵酵素玄米が美味しいという声が多くあります。また、改装された古民家の魅力的で落ち着いた雰囲気も特徴です。ゆったりと食事ができる完璧な場所だと感じている人が多く、健康的で丁寧に作られた料理に感謝する声も聞かれます。

rv.t: 麻賀多神社（台方）本殿裏の集落内に「知る人ぞ知る」「予約推奨」という人気の営業店を見つけたので、ランチしましょ♪ かまど炊き発酵酵素玄米を使っているという2018年開業の「古民家カフェ きのこくらぶ」さん。 ちなみに今回は、予約無し「いきなり飛び込み」で入店しましたけど、普通に入れて貰えましたよ♪ 11：00開店と同時に次から次へと客が来て、20席ある店内はあっという間に満席です！ レトロな看板が「イイ味」出していますね。 お店の中は、お洒落な山小屋風の感じに綺麗にリフォームされていました。 先ず、受付でオーダーするものを決めてから、係の人に指定された席に着席。 ※会計は食後でOK メインの定食（ランチ）メニューは、「魚（1500円）」と「肉（1600円）」から選べます（税込）。 お冷はセルフサービスとの事。 店内デザインも、落ち着いたレトロなイメージのインテリアで統一されていますね。 やや薄暗い感じの照明も、イイ感じ♪…

古民家カフェ巡りを始めたきっかけのお店です。 メイン道路から１本中に入ったところにあり、ちょっとわかりずらいですが、それがまた魅力。 外観も内観もとてもステキなお店です。 ランチタイムに伺いましたが、おしゃれなプレートで味もよくとっても美味しかったです。デザートもちょっとおしゃれで、インスタ映えするし、とても美味しかったです。コーヒーにもこだわりがあるようで、さすがに限定コーヒーには手が出ませんでしたが、ランチコーヒーも十分美味しかったです。
古民家ならではの落ち着いた空間でいただく、体にやさしい定食。蒸籠にたっぷり詰まった野菜は彩りもよく、素材の味がしっかり感じられるのが印象的。きのこを使った副菜も滋味深く、玄米ごはんと具だくさんの汁物で満足感も十分。丁寧に作られているのが伝わってくる内容で、ゆっくり過ごしたい日にぴったりのお店でした。
